title: orbitopt cross-environment exchange envelope (CrossEnvExchange v1)
description: The sealed handoff one cross-environment mission stage writes for the next (task #270, E5-03): the artifacts a leg produced (FlightRun directories, M-01 HandoffState documents, reports -- each in its own versioned orbitopt format, never a crossenv-private serialization), a SHA-256 digest per artifact (a run-dir digests over the sorted per-file digests of its contents), and the provenance of the environment that produced them, so the consumer can see -- not assume -- that tudatpy and gfold ran where they must. Read via orbitopt.crossenv.envelope.read_envelope, which re-computes every digest and refuses a mismatch: a changed artifact is corruption or tampering, never a hint. Compatibility policy as everywhere: unknown OPTIONAL fields are ignored; removing/renaming/narrowing gets crossenv-exchange-2.0.json.

stage.description: The plan stage id that produced this exchange.

runner.description: The stage runner that produced it; a reader dispatches behaviour on the payload types, never on this.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the envelope was sealed.

environment.description: Provenance of the producing interpreter: the label the plan gave it, the executable, its Python version, the platform, and the orbitopt toolchain matrix (orbitopt.flightlab.toolchain.toolchain_record) -- the acceptance evidence for 'recorded in provenance'.

payloads.description: The sealed artifacts. Paths are POSIX-relative to the exchange directory and may not escape it.

schema_version.description: The schema version of the payload's own format (FlightRun / handoff-state / report) as sealed -- the reader's native parser enforces its current version independently.

path.description: Relative to the exchange dir; absolute paths and '..' are rejected at seal time.

digest.description: file: SHA-256 over the bytes. run-dir: SHA-256 over the sorted '<posix-path>\t<file-digest>' listing of the directory, domain-prefixed 'orbitopt.crossenv.run-dir.v1'.

report_kind.description: The embedded kind a 'report' document must carry; cross-checked at read.
